productOnPage.descriptionHtml:
Join Willa and her loyal dog Woof in two more thrilling adventures from author Jacqueline Harvey!

This card contain books 5 and 6 in the Willa and Woof series:


Willa and Woof 5: Let the Games Begin -

It’s oldies versus kids when Sunset Views Retirement Village hosts its very first Tournament of the Ages!

Willa’s helping plan the event, but one of the older kids on the committee doesn’t want her there. Plus, she needs to find time to train for her first ever proper gymnastics competition!

She’ll need the help of Tae, her best same-age friend, to stand up to her bully; Frank, her best old-age friend, to practise her vault routine; and Woof, her best four-legged friend, for moral support.

Can Willa juggle it all?

 

Willa and Woof 6: Double the Drama -


The school is putting on a play about sea creatures and Willa is a shark.

But the new kid, Rory, is coming between Willa and Tae, Willa’s best same-age friend. Plus Frank, her best old-age friend, is acting strangely too.

She’ll need the help of Woof, her best four-legged friend, to sort out her friendships, practise her lines and save the school production in time.

Can Willa deal with all the drama?
